methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

BEAR.desc: EPS -46.3%/yr (worst year FY08-FY16 ex-FY15, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +4.1%/yr (Q4 sales ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY15 ex-FY17 median

BULL.desc: EPS +8.8%/yr (FY08-FY16 ex-FY15 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +48.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY16 ex-FY15); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2018-03-09) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.58x (83.8% downside to Bear $11 / +53.1% upside to Bull $104) | Adj composite 2.06 vs market 2.34: gap -0.28 [MODESTLY OVERVALUED] | +23% above the EPP floor $55 (18x FY18E $3.08) | Conservative 2-yr case: -0.7% total (-0.3%/yr) | At 22.1x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $90 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; U.S. revenues +6.9% in Q4 2017, forward revenues +2% (no FY18 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2017 net sales growth ex-FX); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
